summary: Choose at most three available skills whose non-overlapping workflows materially improve a complex task.

scenarios.title: Route a multi-domain task
scenarios.prompt: Use the select-task-skills skill for this repository task and choose no more than three skills that materially improve it.
scenarios.outcome: A short use-now or install-first selection based on actual triggers, with overlapping candidates omitted.

scenarios.title: Discover project-local skills
scenarios.prompt: Use the select-task-skills skill to check whether this project declares a skill for the unfamiliar workflow I requested.
scenarios.outcome: A catalog-backed recommendation that does not install, enable, update, or remove any skill.
